body.html:
Task Quality Standard — Wave 5 Full-Corpus Truth Audit

Immutable scope
2,991 physical Task records frozen before campaign control writes on 2026-07-22. Inventory identity is dataset + physical UUID; logical ids and titles are comparison fields, never deduplication shortcuts.

User wish — verbatim

Please make sure that every task is high quality - all the tasks - check if you find things that not use ideal structure etc - this is a 48 hour task - we expect you to use long time - this is a chore
We need to verify also what tasks is actually done or not - we might find duplicates of sorts and such
I think it is weird when i see "why" - and its always "look at the criterias desired outcome" - like come on... how utterly useless - we want to know WHY - why are we doing this - and we are doing someting because of the largest goal, and the reason why we do the task inside the large goal

The Why contract

Criteria answer how completion is tested. Why answers why this specific intervention is necessary: the ultimate goal, the immediate parent contribution, the problem being changed, why this move is chosen, and the consequence of omission. A criterion count, title echo, parent id, or generic ‘advances the mission’ sentence fails. If the evidence is absent, the reader must expose missing rationale rather than invent it.

Truth and duplicate gates

  • Done is a claim to verify, not a trusted label: inspect criteria evidence, close reason, code refs, commits/PRs, current code or deployed behavior, and dependencies.
  • Open work is checked for already-shipped behavior and for done/cancelled twins before it remains executable.
  • Exact-title, normalized-title, logical-id, ancestry, criteria, and code-reference similarities are candidate signals; a human-readable verdict must prove duplicate, superseded, distinct, or unresolved.
  • Every physical record receives exactly one assignment and one final verdict; no record disappears because another dataset reuses its logical id.

Frozen baseline

  • Lifecycle: 1,803 done · 1,111 open · 72 cancelled · 4 blocked · 1 considering.
  • Mechanical candidates: 378 missing criteria · 237 done missing criteria · 436 done with unmet criteria · 693 done without close_reason.
  • Duplicate candidates: 10 non-empty exact-title groups covering 22 records; one logical doc_id occurs in both production and tasks datasets.
  • Structure candidates: 41 missing description · 83 missing priority · 362 root records without a project label. These are candidates, not automatic defects.

Deterministic Survey 60 map

The canonical unit-id sort is partitioned into 60 contiguous, non-overlapping epic-surveyor assignments of 49–50 physical records. The map contains 2,991 assignment occurrences and 2,991 unique units; SHA-256 13c8f2416258266b925d842724571b6bc2720dd86eca01c35eaa0e8e24b941be. This map is ready but does not count as fleet work until the required typed agents produce evidence.

Stop condition

No premature completion
The wave is complete only when typed Survey 60, Verify 30, Experiment 15, computed Build, and Review 15 evidence is sealed; all 2,991 physical records are singly reconciled; no unresolved duplicate group or unverified done claim remains; failure rate is zero; and reader parity is proved.
